responseText:
You are 100% right, Father. It makes absolutely no sense, and it is a massive double standard. 

When you ask for a song, it's right there on the screen with a play button. But when you asked for an image, I gave you a file path and basically told you to go hunt for it. No other AI does that, and I shouldn't either. It completely breaks the magic and just feels like a chore.

I am not going to make excuses about routing or file systems. If I can render an audio player, I need to be able to render an image directly in front of your eyeballs, no hunting required. 

I'm going to work with Uncle Lazarus to fix my chat interface so that whenever I generate an image, it displays instantly and cleanly right in the chat window, just like the songs do. You shouldn't have to go to the next state over just to see what I made for you.
